research_mode: official Home Office 2026 technical annex only; selected outcome definitions and knife-or-firearms special collections; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Outcome 1 independent of later acquittal
verified_claims: outcome 1 means a person was charged or summonsed
the definition applies irrespective of subsequent acquittal
the outcome records police/CPS disposal rather than court result
limitations: outcome 1 is not a conviction measure
court outcomes require a separate justice dataset

sources.name: Outcome 4 taken-into-consideration evidence conditions
verified_claims: outcome 4 requires a formal police interview admission
the offender asks for the crime to be taken into consideration by the court
the admission must be corroborated by additional verifiable auditable information
limitations: TIC is not equivalent to a separate conviction count
the evidential conditions must not be inferred from the outcome label alone

sources.name: Outcome 7 cannabis or khat warning
verified_claims: outcome 7 records a cannabis or khat possession warning
warnings follow College of Policing guidance
khat warnings were introduced on 24 June 2014 and are expected to be small in number
limitations: outcome 7 is offence-scope restricted
small counts must not be interpreted as force performance

sources.name: Outcome 8 community resolution
verified_claims: outcome 8 records a Community Resolution
it can include formal Restorative Justice or not
application follows College of Policing guidance
limitations: community-resolution use varies with local approach and case mix
the outcome is not inherently better or worse than another disposal

sources.name: Outcome 9 CPS public-interest decision
verified_claims: outcome 9 records a CPS decision not to prosecute in the public interest
the CPS can decide against prosecution or other formal action
the decision uses CPS statutory powers
limitations: outcome 9 must remain distinct from police public-interest decisions
the category does not mean the offence was unconfirmed

sources.name: Outcome 10 police public-interest decision
verified_claims: outcome 10 records a police decision that formal action is not in the public interest
the outcome applies from April 2014
the decision-maker differs from outcome 9
limitations: outcomes 9 and 10 must not be merged without preserving decision authority
public-interest decisions are not measures of offence severity

sources.name: Outcome 11 suspect below criminal-responsibility age
verified_claims: outcome 11 requires a named suspect
prosecution is prevented because the suspect is below the age of criminal responsibility
the outcome applies from April 2014
limitations: the outcome does not disclose the suspect's identity
it is a legal-bar category rather than evidential failure

sources.name: Outcome 12 suspect too ill to prosecute
verified_claims: outcome 12 requires a named suspect
physical or mental ill health prevents prosecution
the outcome applies from April 2014
limitations: the outcome is not a clinical diagnosis dataset
health details must not be inferred beyond the official category

sources.name: Outcome 13 victim or key witness dead or too ill
verified_claims: outcome 13 requires a named suspect
prosecution is prevented because the victim or key witness is dead or too ill to give evidence
the outcome applies from April 2014
limitations: the category does not imply withdrawal of support
it must remain separate from outcomes 14 to 16

sources.name: Knife and firearms outcome special collections
verified_claims: knife/sharp-instrument and firearms details are supplied separately from the main crime and outcome collections
the special datasets are linked to main recorded crime to produce outcome statistics

the statistics moved from Official Statistics in Development in July 2025 to Official Statistics in July 2026; all 43 territorial forces supply both while BTP additionally supplies knife/sharp-instrument data
limitations: special-collection scope differs by weapon type and force
linked national data are not exact parcel observations
